criteria.description: Use object destructuring to read name and stock from a product, with a default category. Demonstrate missing category versus a present category. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use map to add a displayLabel to copied products. Show original objects have no new displayLabel property. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement lowStockNames(products,threshold) with filter/map. Check equality at 4, above threshold, and an empty array. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use reduce with initial value 0 to total price*stock. Test the 3500 fixture and empty input. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create state={products:[...]}; replace one product stock using object spread and map. Demonstrate both original stock and unrelated product values remain unchanged. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Move calculations to calculations.js with named exports and import from an ES module entry. Run with browser type=module or correctly configured Node modules and record the setup. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Read an optional supplier name with optional chaining and ?? fallback. Show absent supplier and an intentionally empty string; explain why || may behave differently. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
